templates.name: Recruiter — warm intro / follow-up
templates.when: After applying, to a named recruiter at the company
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

I recently applied for the {role} role at {company} and wanted to introduce myself directly. My background in {your_strength} lines up closely with what the role calls for, and I'm genuinely excited about {company_hook}.

Would you be open to a quick chat about the team and what you're looking for? Happy to work around your schedule.

Thanks so much,
Alex Doe

templates.name: Hiring Manager — post-application nudge
templates.when: 3–5 days after applying, if you can find the HM
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

I applied for the {role} role on your team and didn't want it to get lost in the pile. In my current work I've {quantified_win}, which maps directly to {role_focus}.

I'd love 15 minutes to hear how you're thinking about this hire. Either way, thanks for considering my application.

Best,
Alex

templates.name: Post-interview thank-you
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today about the {role} role. I especially enjoyed {specific_topic} — it reinforced how well the team's direction fits what I'm looking for.

If any follow-up questions come up as you evaluate candidates, I'm glad to help. Looking forward to next steps.

Warmly,
Alex Doe

templates.name: Network — referral ask
templates.when: To a 1st/2nd-degree connection at a target company
templates.body:
Hey {first_name},

Hope you're doing well! I'm exploring {role}-type roles and noticed {company} has an opening that's a strong fit ({role}). Given your time there, would you feel comfortable referring me or pointing me to the right person? Happy to send my resume and a tailored blurb to make it easy.

Really appreciate it either way!
Alex

templates.name: Network — cold outreach to someone in the role
templates.when: To someone who holds a role you're targeting
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

I came across your profile while researching {role} roles at {company} — your path into it is exactly the kind of move I'm working toward. Would you be open to a 15-minute chat about how you got there and what the team values? I'll keep it short and come prepared.

Thanks for considering,
Alex Doe

templates.name: Re-engage a stalled application
templates.when: 2–3 weeks after applying with no response
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

Following up on my application for {role} (submitted {date_applied}). I remain very interested and have {recent_progress} since applying. Is there any update on timing, or anything else useful I can share?

Thanks for your time,
Alex
